content.rationale: The envelope is where invocations meet the substrate and the line-discipline rule; the gate forces shared ownership to answer to both. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
